description: Maandelijkse bestanden met ruwe gegevens van stiptheid is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Ruwe gegevens van vertrek en aankomst van (nationale en internationale) reizigerstreinen op al hun stations per treinnummer en met hun relaties, sinds januari 2014 per maandelijkse bestanden. Vertragingen worden aangegeven in seconden, "negatieve" vertragingen zijn het gevolg van een eerder vertrek of een eerdere aankomst dan verwacht bij de halte. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Traffic beheer. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Reizigers. The portal shows 2025-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
